title: Award Winning Audio Plugins
description: A collection of VST plugins developed for the AES MATLAB Hackathons, including a compressor, reverb, and a vocal processor.

title: GuitarBot Jams
description: A backend for interactive improvisation with Georgia Tech's robotic guitarist.

title: Ravel
description: A RAVE-powered neural audio looper plugin, with torch isolated in a flat-C-ABI DLL for streaming parity.

title: dB Drifter
description: An audiophile roguelite/driving game where sound literally powers your weapons and gear.

title: hearsal
description: A Next.js setlist app that pulls charts from Ultimate Guitar and playlists from Spotify, now with offline/PWA support.

title: Boing
description: A spring-reverb plugin whose character comes from real fluid-loading physics, not a preset bank.

title: jpegify
description: A bit-crusher where a dropped-in image's own JPEG blocks decide what the audio quantizer keeps or kills.

title: Nuker
description: A microwave-themed destruction effect: gamma-ray distortion, pumping compression, and cooking-appliance foley.

title: LoopRouter
description: A live looper VST/AU with a 4×8 send matrix and full OSC remote control, now standalone.
